params.name: before
params.description: The ID of the first object in the previous page. This parameter instructs the API to return the previous page of results.

params.name: after
params.description: The ID of the last object in the previous page. This parameter instructs the API to return the next page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of objects returned in a page. The default value is 50. The minimum value is 1, and the maximum value is 100.

params.name: order
params.description: Specifies the order of the results. Valid values are asc for ascending and desc for descending.

params.name: graph_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the graph to which the files belong.

params.name: status
params.description: Specifies the status of the files to retrieve. Valid values are in_progress, completed or failed.

params.name: file_types
params.description: The extensions of the files to retrieve. Separate multiple extensions with a comma. For example: `pdf,jpg,docx`.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of files with optional filtering by status, graph association, and file type.

params.name: graphId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the Knowledge Graph to associate the uploaded file with.

Note: The response from the upload endpoint does not include the `graphId` field, but the association will be visible when you retrieve the file using the file retrieval endpoint.
